question: How many customers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers

question: How many of our customers are business customers?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'business'

question: How many customers do we have in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT country, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: Which products are out of stock?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE stock = 0

question: What is our most expensive product and its price?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average product price per category, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT category, round(avg(price), 2) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2025-%'

question: How many orders are there in each status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: What is the total amount of all paid invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM invoices WHERE paid_date IS NOT NULL

question: Who are the 5 customers with the highest total invoiced amount, and how much is it?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, round(sum(i.amount), 2) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which products were not ordered at all in June 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2026-06-%')

question: How many unpaid invoices were already overdue on 2026-07-01?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE paid_date IS NULL AND due_date < '2026-07-01'

question: How many customers have not placed any order since 2026-01-01?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01')

question: Which 2 products sold the most units across all orders, and how many units each?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 2

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month

question: What is the average invoice amount for retail versus business customers, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(i.amount), 2) FROM invoices i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: List the names and emails of our customers in Vienna.
gold_sql: SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE city = 'Vienna'

question: Which 2 cities have the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 2

question: How many units did we sell per product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, sum(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: How many orders contain 4 or more different products?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING count(*) >= 4)

question: Which customer has placed the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total invoice amount of refunded orders?
gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(i.amount), 2) FROM invoices i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'refunded'

question: On average, how many days after the invoice date are invoices paid? Round to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT round(avg(julianday(paid_date) - julianday(issued_date)), 1) FROM invoices WHERE paid_date IS NOT NULL

question: Which products cost more than the average product price?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT avg(price) FROM products)

question: Which customers have ordered the Espresso Machine Pro?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Espresso Machine Pro'

question: What percentage of orders were cancelled? Round to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(status = 'cancelled') / count(*), 1) FROM orders

question: When was the most recent order placed?
gold_sql: SELECT max(order_date) FROM orders

question: Which customers signed up in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2026-01-01'

question: Which customers have an unpaid invoice of more than 500?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE i.paid_date IS NULL AND i.amount > 500

question: What was the invoiced revenue per quarter in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT (cast(substr(issued_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS quarter, round(sum(amount), 2) FROM invoices WHERE issued_date LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY quarter
